### **The Theatre of Dreams** The Theatre of Dreams is the biggest football stadium in the UK.
It is in Manchester (M16 0RA), and it can hold more than 74,000 people.
It has a lot of history and is a real football cathedral.
*   The Stretford End (West Stand) is where the most noisy and devoted fans of United are.
For the best vibe, this is the place to be.
*   The North Stand, sometimes known as the Sir Alex Ferguson Stand, is the biggest.
It boasts magnificent views and is where the club museum and trophy room are.
*   The major stand is the Sir Bobby Charlton Stand (South Stand).
There are spaces for the directors and the media.
*   The away fans sit in the East Stand, which is also where the renowned statue of the “United Trinity” – Best, Law, and Charlton – stands.
